newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's defence minister to visit Egypt on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Israel's defence minister to visit Egypt on Tuesday.

text.p: Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai will visit Egypt on Tuesday for talks with President Hosni Mubarak on ways to advance the peace process.
Mordechai will fly on an Israeli airforce plane to the city of Hurghada on the Red Sea. It will be Mordechai's first visit to Egypt since he and his right-wing Likud party were elected in May.
"I hope that in this meeting we will succeed in strengthening relations between the two countries and to find ways to cooperate to advance the peace," Mordechai said in a statement.

"Egypt plays an important role in the advancement of the peace process since it was the first Arab state to sign a peace agreement with Israel," the statement added. Israel and Egypt signed a peace treaty in 1979.
Mordechai said he will brief Mubarak on peace talks between Israel and the Palestinians.
Since the government of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu came to power in June relations between Israel and Egypt have become strained.
